# Set-up
```{r}

cran_packages <- c("knitr", "lme4", "ggeffects", "emmeans", "tidyverse", "here", "DT")

missing_cran <- setdiff(cran_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_cran)
}

require(knitr)
library(lme4)
library(ggeffects)
library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(DT)

inport_dir <- here("data")

# set default code chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F, message = F)

# set default plot theme
theme_set(theme_classic() +
            theme(text = element_text(size = 18)))

# suppress warnings about grouping
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = F)
```

# Data

## LookIt (Online)

### Preprocessing (raw LookIt export -> trial-level data)

```{r}

df.e2b_raw <- as_tibble(read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e2b_childfc.csv")))

# import video review data
df.e2b_video_review_exclusions <-
  as_tibble(read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e2b_child_distraction_data.csv"))) %>%
  select(id, Final.decision, exclusion_reason)

df.e2b_preprocessed <-
  df.e2b_raw %>%
  # merge with video review data
  full_join(df.e2b_video_review_exclusions,
            by = "id")
```


Count exclusions:

```{r}
# children dropped for incomplete sessions
n_distinct(df.e2b_preprocessed$id) -
  n_distinct(filter(df.e2b_preprocessed, completed == TRUE)$id)

# children dropped after video review
n_distinct(filter(df.e2b_preprocessed, completed == TRUE)$id) -
  n_distinct(filter(df.e2b_preprocessed, completed == TRUE,
                    !str_detect(Final.decision, "EXCLUDE"))$id)
```

```{r}
# data wrangling
df.e2b_preprocessed_final <-
    df.e2b_preprocessed %>%
    # filter out incomplete sessions
    filter(completed == TRUE) %>%
    # filter out distracted children
    filter(!str_detect(Final.decision, "EXCLUDE")) %>%
    # filter out break frame data
    filter(trial != "20-trials") %>%
    # select and rename relevant columns
    select(subject = id,
           age = age,
           age_rounded = age_years,
           gender = child__gender,
           question_type = questiontype,
           trial_number = trial,
           response,
           response_filename = child__condition_list)  %>%
    # create new columns
    mutate(trial_type = case_when(
      # rename simple trials
      str_detect(trial_number, "10|11|12|13|14|15") ~ "simple",
      # rename complex trials
      str_detect(trial_number, "16|17|18|19") ~ "complex",
      # rename agent trials
      str_detect(trial_number, "21|22|23") ~ "agent",
      # make NA if none of the above apply (there should be no such cases)
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
      # define correct responses by trial
      correct = case_when(
        # if question type 'harder,' evaluate against correct_stimuli_harder
        (str_detect(trial_number, "trials") &
           question_type == "harder" &
           response_filename %in% correct_stimuli_harder) ~ 1,
        # if question type 'easier,' evaluate against correct_stimuli_easier
        (str_detect(trial_number, "trials") &
           question_type == "easier" &
           response_filename %in% correct_stimuli_easier) ~ 1,
        # for color check 1, 'yellow' is correct
        (trial_number == "7-color-check" &
           response_filename %in% correct_color7) ~ 1,
        # for color check 2, 'green' is correct
        (trial_number == "8-color-check" &
           response_filename %in% correct_color8) ~ 1,
        # for attention check 1, 'blue blocks' is correct
        (trial_number == "24-attention-checks" &
           response_filename %in% correct_blueblocks) ~ 1,
        # for attention check 2, 'red blocks' is correct
        (trial_number == "25-attention-checks" &
           response_filename %in% correct_redblocks) ~ 1,
        # for warmup with 'harder', house is correct
        (trial_number == "9-warmup" &
           question_type == "harder" &
           response_filename == "house.jpg") ~ 1,
        # for warmup with 'easier', triangle is correct
        (trial_number == "9-warmup" &
           question_type == "easier" &
           response_filename == "triangle.png") ~ 1,
        # else, make the value 0 in all of the above cases
        TRUE ~ 0)) %>%
    # pre-screening questions: the color question is passed only if both color
    # checks are correct
    group_by(subject) %>%
    mutate(color_correct = all(correct[str_detect(trial_number, "color-check")] == 1),
           warmup_correct = all(correct[trial_number == "9-warmup"] == 1)) %>%
    # filter out children who failed both pre-screening questions
    filter(color_correct | warmup_correct) %>%
    ungroup()
```

### Trial-Level Data

```{r}
#Change Trial Names
df.e2b_childfc_raw <-
  df.e2b_preprocessed_final %>%
  filter(trial_type != "") %>%
  mutate(trial = case_when(
           str_detect(response_filename, "^1_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Number1",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^2_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Number2",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^3_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Number3",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^4_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Number4",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^7_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Num_Stab",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^15_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Stability1",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^5_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Process1",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^6_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Process2",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^11_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Process3",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^12_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Probability",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^16_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Child_Adult",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^17_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Sling",
           str_detect(response_filename, "^18_Fin_LD_NB_") ~ "Cooperation",
           TRUE ~ response_filename))

# create mapping for trial order
unique_trials <-
  sort(unique(as.numeric(str_extract(df.e2b_childfc_raw$trial_number, "\\d+"))))
trial_mapping <-
  setNames(seq_along(unique_trials), unique_trials)

df.e2b_childfc_raw <-
  df.e2b_childfc_raw %>%
  select(-c(response, response_filename)) %>%
  mutate(trial_number = as.numeric(str_extract(trial_number, "\\d+")),
         trial_number = trial_mapping[as.character(trial_number)])

df.e2b_childfc_raw <- df.e2b_childfc_raw |>
    mutate(trial = case_when(trial == "Stability1" ~ "Stability",
                           trial == "Num_Stab" ~ "Number&Stability",
                           trial == "Process3" ~ "Pattern",
                           trial == "Sling" ~ "Agent1",
                           trial == "Child_Adult" ~ "Agent2",
                           trial == "Cooperation" ~ "Agent3",
                           .default = trial))

#ensure trial naming is right
df.e2b_childfc_raw |>
  group_by(trial) |>
  summarize(n = n())

#get rid of NAs
df.e2b_childfc <- df.e2b_childfc_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(trial))

```

```{r}
df.e2b_childfc <- df.e2b_childfc %>%
  rename(id = subject) %>%
  select(id, everything())
```

# Process Cleaned Data

```{r}

# children aged 9 and older
n_distinct(filter(df.e2b_childfc, age_rounded >= 9)$id)

df.e2b_childfc <-
  df.e2b_childfc %>%
  # filter out 9s
  filter(age_rounded < 9) %>%
  # filter out missing trials
  filter(trial != "")

```

# Demographic Information

```{r}

df.e2b_childfc |>
  distinct(id, age, gender) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n(),
                   n_3to5 = sum(age < 6),
                   n_6to8 = sum(age >= 6),
                   n_girls = sum(gender == "f"),
                   n_boys = sum(gender == "m"),
                   # "o" in the LookIt export
                   n_other = sum(gender == "o"),
                   mean_age = mean(age), sd_age = sd(age),
                   min_age = min(age), max_age = max(age))

```

# Analyses

```{r}

df.e2b_online <- df.e2b_childfc |>
  select(id, age, gender, question_type, trial, correct) |>
  mutate(age_group = if_else(age < 6, "3-5", "6-8"))

```

## Performance vs. Chance by Age Group

```{r}

model_e2b_vs_chance_3to5 <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + question_type + (1|id),
      data = filter(df.e2b_online, age_group == "3-5"), family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

model_e2b_vs_chance_6to8 <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + question_type + (1|id),
      data = filter(df.e2b_online, age_group == "6-8"), family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_3to5, terms = "trial") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(above_chance = conf.low > .5)

ggemmeans(model_e2b_vs_chance_6to8, terms = "trial") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(above_chance = conf.low > .5)

```


## Age Model

Per our pre-registration: the maximal model (random intercept for subject,
`bobyqa` optimizer) failed to converge, so per the pre-registered fallback
plan we iteratively reduce the model -- dropping the random effect of
subject and the `bobyqa` optimizer and fitting the fixed-effects-only model
below. (The maximal model fails on the online sample alone as well as on the
combined sample.)

```{r}

# Logistic regression for children, run on the online sample
# random intercept removed because the model did not converge
model_e2bchildfc_online <- glm(correct ~ 1 + trial + age + question_type + trial:age,
                         family = "binomial",
      data = df.e2b_online)

model_e2bchildfc_online |>
  joint_tests()

```

Overall Regression

```{r}

ggemmeans(model = model_e2bchildfc_online, terms = "trial")
ggemmeans(model = model_e2bchildfc_online, terms = "age")
ggemmeans(model = model_e2bchildfc_online, terms = "question_type")

```

Age point analysis:

```{r}

# Now do the age point analysis

e2b_age_range <- seq(3, 9, by = .01)

emm_options(rg.limit = 20000)

e2b_age_analysis_raw <- ggemmeans(model = model_e2bchildfc_online,
          terms = c("age [e2b_age_range]", "trial"))

df.e2b_age_analysis <- data.frame(age = e2b_age_analysis_raw$x,
           trial = e2b_age_analysis_raw$group,
           lowerCI = e2b_age_analysis_raw$conf.low)

df.e2b_age_analysis <- df.e2b_age_analysis |>
  group_by(trial) |>
  mutate(passed = ifelse(any(lowerCI > 0.50), "passed", "did not pass .5")) |>
  ungroup()

df.e2b_passed_min <- df.e2b_age_analysis %>%
  filter(passed == "passed",
         lowerCI > .5) %>%
  group_by(trial) %>%
  summarise(min_age = min(age))

df.e2b_no_pass <- df.e2b_age_analysis |>
  filter(passed == "did not pass .5") |>
  group_by(trial) |>
  summarise(min_age = "did not pass .5")

# Predictions and generate html table
df.e2b_age_predictions <- rbind(df.e2b_passed_min, df.e2b_no_pass)

options(max.print = nrow(df.e2b_age_predictions))

kable(df.e2b_age_predictions,
      format = "html", table.attr = "style = \"color: white;\"",
      caption = "Merged")

```
